description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to navigation, including help, page top modifications, menu link alterations, block modifications, element info alterations, and module installation handling within the Drupal navigation module.

classes.name: NavigationHooks
classes.description: A class implementing various Drupal hooks for navigation functionality, including help display, page modifications, menu alterations, block and element adjustments, and module installation responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as module handler, current user, navigation renderer, config action manager, and top bar item manager.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help content for navigation and layout builder routes, including documentation links.

methods.name: pageTop
methods.description: Modifies the page top region to include navigation elements if the user has permission.

methods.name: menuLinksDiscoveredAlter
methods.description: Adds menu links related to navigation content.

methods.name: blockBuildLocalTasksBlockAlter
methods.description: Alters local task blocks to remove navigation if the user has permission.

methods.name: pluginFilterBlockLayoutBuilderAlter
methods.description: Filters blocks available in the layout builder UI based on navigation section storage.

methods.name: pluginFilterLayoutLayoutBuilderAlter
methods.description: Prevents adding new sections in layout builder for navigation sections.

methods.name: blockAlter
methods.description: Adds attributes to blocks related to navigation and hides certain blocks from UI.

methods.name: elementInfoAlter
methods.description: Adds pre-render callbacks to layout builder elements.

methods.name: navigationWorkspaces
methods.description: Provides navigation links for workspaces if the module is enabled and user has permissions.

methods.name: modulesInstalled
methods.description: Handles actions after modules are installed, adding default navigation blocks.

methods.name: navigationMenuLinkTreeAlter
methods.description: Removes specific links from the admin menu tree.
